record.original_question: Construct examples of Finsler metrics of constant curvature on S^2 that are not Zoll and such that they admit no Killing vector field.

evidence.quote: Construct examples of Finsler metrics of constant curvature on S^2 that are not Zoll and such that they admit no Killing vector field.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $S^2$ be the 2-sphere. A Finsler metric on $S^2$ is a continuous function $F: TS^2 \to [0,\infty)$, smooth and positive away from the zero section, positively homogeneous of degree one in the fiber variable (i.e., $F(x,\lambda v)=\lambda F(x,v)$ for $\lambda>0$), and whose vertical Hessian $\tfrac{1}{2}\partial^2 F^2/\partial v^i\partial v^j$ is positive definite on $TS^2\setminus\{0\}$. Such an $F$ has constant flag curvature $K\in\mathbb{R}$ if its flag curvature, the Finsler analogue of the Riemannian sectional curvature, equals $K$ at every flag $(x;v,w)$.

A Finsler metric $F$ is called Zoll if every geodesic of $F$ is periodic. A vector field $X$ on $S^2$ is a Killing field for $F$ if its local flow preserves $F$, i.e., $F\circ d\varphi_t = F$ for the flow $\varphi_t$ of $X$.

Problem. Construct an example of a Finsler metric $F$ on $S^2$ such that:
(i) $F$ has constant flag curvature;
(ii) $F$ is not Zoll (i.e., $F$ has at least one non-closed geodesic);
(iii) $F$ admits no nontrivial Killing vector field.

Equivalently, exhibit such a metric, or prove that no such metric exists.
artifact.category_tag: Finsler metrics of constant curvature on the 2-sphere
artifact.status_search_result: The literature on Finsler 2-spheres of constant flag curvature provides strong structural results: reversible such metrics are Riemannian (Bryant); for non-reversible metrics with $K\equiv 1$, the geodesic flow is conjugate to that of a Katok metric (Kim and others). Metrics admitting a Killing field have an explicit normal form (Bryant 2017). However, no construction of a non-Zoll, constant-curvature Finsler metric on $S^2$ without any Killing field appears in the literature; Katok-type examples and their geodesic-flow conjugates all carry an $S^1$-symmetry. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: On Finsler surfaces of constant flag curvature with a Killing field
status_evidence.snippet: Two-dimensional Finsler metrics of constant flag curvature that admit a Killing field can be written in a normal form that depends on two arbitrary functions of one variable.
status_evidence.claim: Provides a classification only under the assumption that a Killing field exists; the case without Killing field is not addressed.

status_evidence.title: Geodesic behavior for Finsler metrics of constant positive flag curvature on S^2
status_evidence.snippet: The geodesic flow of every such metric is conjugate to that of one of Katok's examples.
status_evidence.claim: Known constant-curvature examples have geodesic flows conjugate to Katok metrics, which carry Killing fields, but conjugacy of geodesic flows does not produce a metric without Killing field.

status_evidence.title: Geodesically reversible Finsler 2-spheres of constant curvature (Bryant)
status_evidence.snippet: A reversible Finsler metric of constant flag curvature on the 2-sphere is necessarily Riemannian.
status_evidence.claim: Reversible case is fully resolved, leaving the non-reversible non-symmetric case as the remaining frontier.
